Success ek safar hai, manzil nahi.
Agar simple explain nahi, understanding abhi nahi.
Chahe tum socho ki tum kar sakte ho, ya tum socho ki tum nahi kar sakte—tum sahi ho.
Effort ka substitute nahi.
Perseverance sab jeet leti hai.
"Courage fear ka absence nahi—us par triumph."
Peeche kya hua, wo matter nahi karta.
Success final nahi; failure fatal nahi.
Jeetna hai toh haarna seekho.
Mind woh seekhta jo repeat karta.
Attitude height decide karta hai.
Taqat sharir se nahi, majboot iraade se aati hai.
